name: Camp Trek Teen Adventure Camp
description_short: Town run trip camp in Merrimack for kids entering grades 5 to 9, offered as an alternative to the Naticook day camp. Each weekday the group goes on a field trip somewhere in New England, such as state parks and beaches, paddleboarding, trampoline parks, amusement parks and ball games.
refund_policy_summary: Each session has a $50 nonrefundable deposit and the balance is due 45 days before it starts. Cancel at least 30 days ahead and lose only the deposit; 15 to 30 days ahead, get 50% of what was paid less the deposit; no refunds within 15 days. Medical cancellations with a doctor's letter get 50% of the remainder less the deposit.
notes: Camp runs 8 am to 4 pm; AM care 7 to 8 am ($30 a week) and PM care 4 to 6 pm ($60 a week). Tuition is $355 a week for Merrimack residents and $405 for non residents, with a $25 sibling discount, and covers trip transportation and admissions. Scholarships are for Merrimack residents who meet income rules.
